title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description:
Reteach is an LMS (Learning Management System) platform. I led and implemented several high-impact frontend initiatives:

  • Migrating the WYSIWYG editor from CKEditor to Tiptap (ProseMirror) — defining the component and extension architecture, and implementing the most customer-demanded features (floating link menu, font colors, multi-color selector, context-aware toolbar, three-dot menu)
  • Leading the full i18n strategy and Lokalise integration from scratch — defining key naming conventions, implementing a shared vue-i18n configuration package in the Nx monorepo, and proposing a novel Vue component interpolation solution
  • Introducing Story Points and velocity tracking to improve sprint estimation and delivery forecasting
  • Designing and leading the Frontend Engineer interview process end-to-end (coding challenge, feedback loop, candidate follow-ups)
  • Building the Engineering Wiki, open-sourcing the nuxt-compose-icons library, and setting up the shared UI library with Storybook in the Nx monorepo
